name: Yasser Kobeissi

opening.t: you found it. most people stop at the behance link.
i'm yasser. creative director. riyadh, via beirut. twenty years of making things that exist for one night and then i do it again.
before we go on. what do i call you?

afterName.t: scroll. i'll talk. you'll touch things. that is the deal.

nameJokes.short: {len} letters. mine has fourteen. i win, but it's close.
nameJokes.long: {len} letters. i've designed badges for less. we'll make it fit.
nameJokes.mid: {len} letters. good badge name. not every name is a badge name.

timeJokes.night: i'm up. of course i'm up.
timeJokes.morning: i've had one coffee. ask me anything after the second.
timeJokes.day: the client just called. the client always just called.
timeJokes.evening: doors open in an hour somewhere. they always do.

stops.line: beirut. a bookshop that needed posters. i was the guy with the markers.
ten years of television. four channels. a thousand lower-thirds. i can still do one in my sleep, and i have.
then the phone call. riyadh. 'can you build a stage by friday?' i said yes before i asked which friday.
i came for the opportunity. i stayed because they let me build a village in a weekend.
riyadh. 1,515 km from where it started. feels like further. feels like home.

tv.label: 02 · the tv years
tv.intro: ten years of broadcast. i ran the graphics for four channels at once. press the remote. i'll tell you what each one did to me.

channels.name: SPORTS
channels.ticker: LIVE · RIYADH DERBY · 88' · 2–2 · VAR CHECK IN PROGRESS
channels.line: sports. ten lower-thirds a minute. the score changed faster than the graphics. i learned speed here.

channels.name: NEWS
channels.ticker: BREAKING · GRAPHICS DEPARTMENT ASKS FOR A SECOND COFFEE · MARKETS REACT
channels.line: news. eleven a minute, and every one of them had to be right. i learned precision here. and fear.

channels.name: TALK
channels.ticker: TONIGHT · THREE GUESTS · ONE OPINION · ZERO BREAKS
channels.line: talk shows. one ident, forty bumpers, a host who changed his mind at 7:58. i learned patience here. briefly.

channels.name: DOCS
channels.ticker: DOCUMENTARY · THE MAKING OF EVERYTHING · PART 4 OF 4
channels.line: documentaries. slow, beautiful, nobody watched them live. i learned craft here. it is the one i miss.

loud.label: 03 · loud
loud.intro: i am the loud one in the room. the work is the quiet one. both on purpose. turn it up.
levels: silence. my mother would be proud.
mdl beast, edition one. pepsico. the ground moved.
edition two. we added more. of everything.
edition three. my ears still ring. worth it.
ok. ok. turn it down. i have neighbours.

car.label: 04 · the car geek
car.intro: nobody asks about this part. i learned car design principles from a professor out of the volkswagen audi group. proportions, stance, the line that goes from the headlight to the tail. here. tune one. i'll tell you the truth.

critique.roofLow: low roof. coupé energy. you want to be noticed. same.
critique.roofHigh: tall roof. practical. you have kids or you're lying.
critique.wheelsBig: big wheels. every designer does this first. every engineer takes them away.
critique.wheelsSmall: small wheels. honest. a little sad.
critique.long: long bonnet. power you don't need. i respect that.
critique.short: short overhangs. city car. fits in a riyadh parking spot, which is a design brief on its own.
critique.stanceWide: wide stance. planted. this one is good. i'd draw it twice.
critique.default: balanced. clean. you'd sell it. you wouldn't love it. keep going.

next.label: 05 · what's next
next.intro: people ask what's next. honestly? no idea. that is the best part of this job. pull it.

drawer.label: 06 · the drawer
drawer.intro: the work, if you insist. thirty-four things that existed for one night. drag the desk. open any.

bye.label: 07 · goodbye
lines: loud in the room, quiet in the work, and i still draw with a marker first.
if you have a date and a venue, i have a plan by friday. which friday is your call.
bye.card: A guest of Yasser Kobeissi · {date} · Riyadh

timeline.label: 02 · twenty years
timeline.intro: twenty years. drag the playhead. every year has an opinion.
years: a bookshop in beirut. posters. my first client paid in books.
learned that a deadline is a deadline even when the printer disagrees.
first motion job. 2d, 3d, whatever the producer called 3d.
a production house. we made ads nobody remembers and i remember all of them.
graduated. graphic design, lau. the degree arrived after the jobs did.
bridge production. four years. learned to render overnight and sleep on the render.
a film director course. i direct everything now, including this sentence.
more broadcast. the lower-third became my handwriting.
arabic tv. live. if it breaks, it breaks on air.
tony robbins said something about business. i bought a better coffee machine.
blue house films. cinematography. learned where the light goes.
head of graphics, lebanese tv. the chair was mine, the deadlines were everyone's.
a thousand idents. i stopped counting at a thousand.
maestro group, sba. four channels at once. four.
documentaries. slow, beautiful, nobody watched them live. i miss them.
riyadh. the phone call. 'a stage by friday.' which friday was not discussed.
thakwa events. my name on the door. the door was mine, the invoices too.
booths, forums, a trophy or two. the marker came back out.
sovyal events. head of creative. a village in a weekend.
national day, founding day, ramadan nights. one night each. all of them, still here.
this website. you. hi.

notes.flight: 1,515 km. he still says 'back home' about both ends.
notes.tv: press 02. he flinches. it's the news.
notes.loud: it goes to 11. don't ask why. ask why not.
notes.car: he will critique your car. he critiques his own.
notes.next: the machine has never once said 'sleep' twice.
notes.drawer: thirty-four. not all of them. the ones he'd show his mother.
notes.timeline: every year has an opinion. so does he.

notFound: this room does not exist. neither did most of mine until friday.
